observations: 4 photos show a monocrystalline, half-cut-cell solar panel with white backsheet and silver aluminium frame, front and back views.
Photo 3 shows a junction box with two MC4 connectors and a small white specification sticker, but the text on the sticker is too small/blurred to read any wattage, brand or model.
Watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' appears across photos; location metadata reads 'Lagos, Nigeria' even though the buyer's market is Oyo.
No cell count, wattage or brand name is legible anywhere in the four images.
The seller's text describes 'battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours' - this describes a battery, not the solar panel shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours, never repaired
claims.evidence: All four photos show a solar panel, not a battery; the claim does not match the item pictured, so it cannot be a true description of this listing's goods.

claims.claim: Implied: this is an original/new panel (from seller business name and clean appearance)
claims.evidence: No brand/model/wattage sticker is readable in any photo (closest attempt in photo 3 is blurred).

risks.risk: Wattage and brand cannot be confirmed, so true price tier is unknown
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rear specification label showing wattage, model and brand
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest wattage tier seen in comparable listings for an unbranded/unverified mono panel

risks.risk: Seller's text talks about a battery, suggesting either a copy-paste error, a mixed listing, or a bait to confuse buyers about what is actually for sale
risks.proof: A video or photo set that matches the described battery item, or an explicit correction from seller confirming the panel-only listing
risks.if_unproven: treat the listing as unverifiable for any battery-related claim; price only the panel seen in photos

risks.risk: Condition (new vs used) cannot be confirmed from static photos; panels could be used/refurbished despite clean look
risks.proof: A video showing panel output on a multimeter or inverter display under sunlight

risks.risk: Geotag says Lagos while seller claims Oyo-area operation; photos may be stock images from a different batch/location
risks.proof: A fresh photo with visible date/location matching Oyo, or a live video call showing the actual panel in seller's shop
risks.if_unproven: treat the specific unit's location/availability as unverified

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the rear specification label (wattage, Voc, Isc, brand, model, cell count).
A video or live photo call showing the panel generating current on a multimeter/inverter in daylight.
Clarification and correct photos if a battery is actually part of this listing, since the text does not match the images.
Confirmation of current physical location (Oyo) with a fresh timestamped photo.
response.reason: The item is clearly a solar panel, but no photo shows a readable wattage/model/brand, which is the detail that sets its price tier, and the seller's text describes an unrelated battery item.
